name: BEYOND THE HARBOR
source:
BEYOND THE HARBOR is a nonlinear furry visual novel set in the seaside town of Harborton, Virginia. It follows Ollie, a young man who spends a bit too much time in his own head.

It's the final weekend of summer, and following a recent tragedy, old faces are returning to the town they all once called home. How will Ollie cope with these sudden changes as life itself comes closing in? 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200814024830/https://harmoyena.itch.io/beyond-the-harbor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《BEYOND THE HARBOR》是一部非线性毛茸茸的视觉小说，以弗吉尼亚州的海滨小镇哈伯顿为背景。故事讲述的是年轻人奥利，他花了太多时间思考自己的想法。

这是夏天的最后一个周末，在最近发生的一场悲剧之后，老面孔们又回到了他们曾经称之为家的小镇。随着生命的临近，奥利将如何应对这些突然的变化？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200814024830/https://harmoyena.itch.io/beyond-the-harbor]Itch.io[/url]]
